Title: Vast Wealth and Guruhi Are The Land

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I know that, generally speaking, you may untap with Guruhi are the Land after
equipping with Vast Wealth.

I also know that, when using Magic of the Smith, you may still untap with
Guruhi Are The Land even if you do not find a piece of equipment.

So, I assume the answer to this question is "yes".
But of course I was thinking about it:

Lumumba has Vast Wealth.
Lumumba takes the Vast Wealth action.
The first piece of equipment in my library is a Kali's Fang (and therefore
burns, since it is not equippable by Lumumba).
Can Lumumba play Guruhi Are The Land now, to untap?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You neglected to mention if the Vast Wealth action was blocked or was
successful.
By the "therefore burns", it seems as if the Vast Wealth action was
successful.

If the action was successful, then card text: "If this is an equip
action, this Guruhi untaps if the action is successful."
